sections.title: Sound of the letter pe
paragraphs: The letter is called (pe) /pe/. Its main sound is heard in the word (pan) /ˈpan/, which means bread. This letter makes only one sound in Spanish. You can recognise it easily because it always keeps this same basic value.

sections.title: How to say pe
paragraphs: Press your two lips firmly together to stop the air. Release them suddenly without any puff of breath. Keep your vocal cords still so the sound stays voiceless. Touch your throat with your hand to make sure it does not vibrate when the lips open.

sections.title: Spelling of pe
paragraphs: This letter always produces the same sound in all positions. You find it at the start of a word in (pan) /ˈpan/. You also hear it between vowels in (copa) /ˈko.pa/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of breath like the p in the English word pet. Put a paper before your mouth and keep it still as you speak.
